COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

3. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

5. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.

6. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.

7. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

8. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.

11. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

12. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Program Development Overview and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Identifiers and Operators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures 3.5 Data Structures 3.6 Functions Page 15 of 72 1 STRAND 1.0: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
